title: Backorder Terms Table for Ship-To Fulfillment Accounts
content:
Ship-To Fulfillment Account backorder terms by service level. Day counts are calendar days unless marked as business days.

| Service level | Later backorder shipment charged freight again | Backorder fill by second day air free of expedite fee on request | Backorder notice (business days after booking) | Auto-cancel (calendar days after the backorder date) | One-time extension (calendar days) | Substitute offered with no confirmed fill date (calendar days after the backorder date) | Substitute billed at the lower price | Backorder fill price basis | Default shipping of available quantity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Corbett Parcel Ship-To | yes | no | 2 | 60 | 30 | 14 | yes | price in effect on the ship date | ship as available |
| Corbett Standard Ship-To | yes | no | 1 | 60 | 30 | 14 | yes | price in effect on the ship date | ship as available |
| Corbett Priority Ship-To | no | yes | 1 | 90 | 45 | 10 | yes | price in effect on the ship date | ship as available |
| Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To | no | yes | 1 | 90 | 45 | 10 | yes | price in effect on the ship date | ship as available |
| Corbett Premier Route Ship-To | no | yes | 1 | 120 | 60 | 7 | yes | price in effect on the ship date | ship as available |
| Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To | no | yes | 1 | 120 | 60 | 7 | yes | price in effect on the ship date | ship as available |

**Column definitions**

- *Later backorder shipment charged freight again* — whether a later shipment of backordered quantity is charged freight again ("no" means backorder fills ship freight-free).
- *Backorder fill by second day air free* — whether a backorder fill ships by second day air at no expedite fee when the customer asks.
- *Backorder notice* — the business days after booking within which the customer is told of a backorder and its expected date.
- *Auto-cancel* — the calendar days after the backorder date after which an unfilled backorder is cancelled unless extended.
- *One-time extension* — the calendar days a customer may extend an open backorder once, before it would auto-cancel.
- *Substitute offered* — the calendar days after the backorder date by which, with no confirmed fill date, Corbett offers an approved substitute.
- *Substitute billed at the lower price* — whether an accepted substitute is billed at the lower of its own price and the original item's price.
- *Backorder fill price basis* — which price a backorder fill is billed at.
- *Default shipping of available quantity* — how available quantity ships when part of an order is backordered, unless the customer asks for ship-complete on the order.

**Points of reading**

- The notice period is counted in business days; the auto-cancel, extension and substitution periods are counted in calendar days.
- Every level bills an accepted substitute at the lower of its own price and the original item's price, bills a backorder fill at the price in effect on its ship date, and ships available quantity as available unless the customer asks for ship-complete on the order.
- At Corbett Parcel Ship-To and Corbett Standard Ship-To a later backorder shipment is charged freight again; at the four higher levels it ships freight-free.
